questions.question: Which rock type forms when magma or lava cools and solidifies?
Which process commonly turns buried sediment into sedimentary rock?
What forms metamorphic rock?
choices: Changes caused by heat and pressure without complete melting
Only the settling of grains in water

questions.question: What is weathering?
choices: The breakdown of rock at or near Earth's surface
Sediment settling out of moving water

questions.question: What is erosion?
choices: The formation of new minerals under heat

questions.question: What is deposition?
In which rock type are fossils most commonly preserved?
Why does slowly cooling magma often produce large mineral crystals?
choices: Large crystals form only under water
Crystals have more time to grow

questions.question: Why can lava cooled quickly at the surface produce fine-grained rock?
choices: Crystals have little time to grow
The lava contains no dissolved elements
Weathering immediately removes all large crystals

questions.question: Why is the rock cycle described as a cycle rather than a single fixed sequence?
choices: Each rock must pass through every step yearly
Rocks can change through several different pathways
All rocks eventually become the same mineral
Only igneous rocks can change type

questions.question: What happens to a rock if it melts completely?
choices: It becomes molten material that can later form igneous rock

questions.question: How can a sedimentary rock become metamorphic rock?
choices: By being moved downstream without changing
By cooling from lava at the surface
By experiencing sufficient heat and pressure while remaining solid
By breaking into loose sand alone

questions.question: Why do many sedimentary rocks contain layers?
choices: Each layer records a separate volcanic eruption
Layers form only when rocks melt
Every layer must contain the same grain size

questions.question: Which process can chemically weather limestone?
choices: Sediment settling on a lake floor

questions.question: What makes a mineral different from a rock?
choices: A mineral has a characteristic composition and ordered crystal structure
A rock must consist of only one element
A mineral is always larger than a rock

questions.question: A rock contains rounded pebbles cemented together. Which origin is most likely?
choices: Solid rock changing under intense heat

questions.question: A river slows as it enters a lake. What is likely to happen to some of its sediment?
choices: It moves faster because the water slows

questions.question: Two rocks have the same mineral composition, but one has much larger crystals. What is a reasonable explanation?
choices: The larger-crystal rock cooled more quickly
The larger-crystal rock cooled more slowly
The smaller-crystal rock had no time to form any crystals
Crystal size alone proves the rocks contain different elements
